title: Augmentation normalization of additive etale Cech edges
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], an open family U, and an injective resolution I [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the fixed lifted additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], form the open inclusion i(W)=(W→X), its section Cech-resolution double complex [def-sc-etale-open-cech-resolution-double-complex] and its total complex T. Alpha in degree n restricts a global resolution section to each degree-zero Cech tuple and includes into T at (0,n). Beta sends an ordinary unit-module Cech cochain [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change] to lifted functions on open subschemes using restrictFunctorGamma inverse, then to I^0 by the resolution augmentation, then includes into T at (n,0). An equivalence a from Sheaf.H(A_X,n) to ordinary Cech homology is normalized when, for every I and every canonical resolution comparison c [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison], every global cycle s and ordinary Cech cycle z with total cycles t_alpha,t_beta whose inclusions equal alpha(s) and beta(z), equality of their total classes implies a(c.globalEquiv([s]))=[z]. No scalar or inverse-image law is part of this definition.

lean.statement:
def IsEtaleAdditiveCechNormalized {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (a : Sheaf.H X.etaleAdditiveSheaf n ≃+
      (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).homology n) : Prop
